name: China Administrative Regions
description: Look up province, prefecture and county level administrative division codes of China.

examples.label: Limit the range to a province
Limit the range by province code

hints.query: Matches the name or the six digit code; typing filters locally, there is nothing to run.
hints.province: After naming a province or its code, only that province and its lower level regions are kept.
hints.level: Pick a level chip to keep only provinces, prefectures or counties; the number on the chip is the entry count under the current conditions.
hints.output: The dataset is a bundled offline snapshot and may lag behind recent changes; the version ships with the result.

faq.q: Why does the page list more than three thousand rows right away?
faq.a: The full dataset is fetched once when the page opens, and the keyword, province and level filters then run locally, so typing stays instant. The numbers on the chips follow the current filters.

faq.q: How many digits does a code have?
faq.a: Always six: the first two digits are the province, the middle two the prefecture, and the last two the county.

faq.q: Can I look up Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan?
faq.a: The snapshot follows the administrative division code series. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan use their own coding systems and are not part of the six digit sequence.
